name: Unit number check
heading: Is your unit number missing?
body: Your shipping address looks like a building with several units (apartment, condo or office). Without a unit number, Canada Post may not be able to deliver your order and it could be returned to us.
noUnit: My address has no unit number
disclaimer: I confirm that my shipping address has no apartment, suite or unit number. I understand that Hera Beauté is not responsible for delays, returns, losses or additional shipping costs resulting from an incomplete address.
doneUnit: Thank you! Unit {{unit}} was added to your shipping address.
doneNone: Thank you, your answer was saved. We will ship to the address as entered.
invalidUnit: Please enter a unit number (letters and numbers, 20 characters max).
error: Something went wrong. Please try again, or contact us if the problem continues.
